title: NAEP age-13 math score, 2020 vs. 2025

source.name: NAEP Long-Term Trend Assessment, mathematics, age 13

notes: NCES described the 2020-2023 math decline as the largest it had recorded in roughly 50 years of the Long-Term Trend assessment. The 2025 administration scored even lower than 2023, confirming no recovery.
